title: ctaudit / CloudTrail report
description: The ctaudit CloudTrail HTML report rebuilt from the event and finding lines ctaudit ships to Loki (--loki, or serve cloudtrail). Loki stores lines at ship time, so the range must cover the scan runs, not the event times.

list.name: principal
list.label: Principal (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the actor ARN, invokedBy, userName or principalId.

list.name: event
list.label: Event name (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the event name.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="event", account=~"$account", region=~"$region"} | json arn="userIdentity.arn", invokedBy="userIdentity.invokedBy", userName="userIdentity.userName", principalId="userIdentity.principalId", eventName="eventName" | __error__="" | label_format actor=`{{ if .arn }}{{ .arn }}{{ else if .invokedBy }}{{ .invokedBy }}{{ else if .userName }}{{ .userName }}{{ else if .principalId }}{{ .principalId }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` | actor=~"$principal" | eventName=~"$event" [$__range]))

panels.title: Write events

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="event", account=~"$account", region=~"$region"} | json readOnly="readOnly", arn="userIdentity.arn", invokedBy="userIdentity.invokedBy", userName="userIdentity.userName", principalId="userIdentity.principalId", eventName="eventName" | __error__="" | label_format actor=`{{ if .arn }}{{ .arn }}{{ else if .invokedBy }}{{ .invokedBy }}{{ else if .userName }}{{ .userName }}{{ else if .principalId }}{{ .principalId }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` | actor=~"$principal" | eventName=~"$event" | readOnly="false" or (readOnly!="true" and eventName!="" and eventName!~"(Describe|Get|List|Lookup|Search|Query|Head|BatchGet|Scan|Select|Assume|Filter|Estimate|Validate|Preview|Simulate|Check|Test|View|Read|Discover|Resolve).*") [$__range]))

panels.description: readOnly=false, or no readOnly field and an event name that is not a read verb.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="event", account=~"$account", region=~"$region"} | json errorCode="errorCode", arn="userIdentity.arn", invokedBy="userIdentity.invokedBy", userName="userIdentity.userName", principalId="userIdentity.principalId", eventName="eventName" | __error__="" | label_format actor=`{{ if .arn }}{{ .arn }}{{ else if .invokedBy }}{{ .invokedBy }}{{ else if .userName }}{{ .userName }}{{ else if .principalId }}{{ .principalId }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` | actor=~"$principal" | eventName=~"$event" | errorCode!="" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" | severity="critical" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" | severity="high" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" | severity="medium" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" | severity="low" [$__range]))

panels.title: Events by account

targets.expr: sum by (account) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="event", account=~"$account", region=~"$region"} | json arn="userIdentity.arn", invokedBy="userIdentity.invokedBy", userName="userIdentity.userName", principalId="userIdentity.principalId", eventName="eventName" | __error__="" | label_format actor=`{{ if .arn }}{{ .arn }}{{ else if .invokedBy }}{{ .invokedBy }}{{ else if .userName }}{{ .userName }}{{ else if .principalId }}{{ .principalId }}{{ else }}unknown{{ end }}` | actor=~"$principal" | eventName=~"$event" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Loki stores each line at the time ctaudit shipped it, not the event time. Pick a time range that covers the scan runs; the real event time is the eventTime column.

panels.title: Findings by severity

targets.expr: sum by (severity) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Loki stores each line at the time ctaudit shipped it, not the event time. Pick a time range that covers the scan runs; the real event time is the event_time column.

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (rule) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" | rule!="" | keep rule [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (actor) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" | actor!="" | keep actor [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (account) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="cloudtrail", kind="finding", account=~"$account", severity=~"$severity"} | json actor="actor", rule="rule" | __error__="" | actor=~"$principal" | keep account [$__range])))
